title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30

ai_review.summary: Matrix‑mixed recording delivers excellent sound while the June 30 1973 show shines with a sweet Dark Star, stellar Playing in the Band and a powerful Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The matrix blend of soundboard and audience gives a balanced, warm mix with clear vocals, deep bass and crisp drums. The performance is praised for Jerry’s vocal work, a gorgeous Dark Star jam, an inspired first‑set flow featuring Playing in the Band and Sugar Magnolia, and tight playing throughout. Overall reviewers are enthusiastic, noting both superb musical moments and high‑quality audio.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.7/5 with consistent praise for both the show’s performance and the matrix recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced soundboard/audience mix; clear vocals, deep bass, good overall balance; some note it isn’t overly crisp but pleasant.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as well‑played with strong transitions (e.g., Playing in the Band into Dark Star). Second set shorter but still energetic; overall flow praised for its country‑rockabilly vibe of mid‑1973.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals highlighted as strong and expressive; wah‑wah pedal peaks noted during solos.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass described as deep and solid, providing a nice low end for the 1973 recording.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal contributions praised; his rhythm guitar work mentioned as part of the fireworks in the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboard tone is a Rhodes electric piano that blends well; occasional Moog discussion noted but clarified.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann's rhythm described as crisp and tight.
